correctness.rationale: Over Fq char p>=7 sextic etale E, over algebraic closure the trace-zero quartic gradient condition yields all six coordinates satisfy t^3-(s2/4)t+c=0. Distinct roots force multiplicity two each by Vandermonde, giving 15 pairing (syntheme) projective lines, and repeated roots yield precisely the 15 duad triple points. Line–point incidence has 45 branches/flags. Frobenius on six factors acts with cycle type lambda partition of 6. For each of 720 S6 permutations the cycle spectra ell_d on 15 lines, p_d on 15 duads, b_d on 45 flags yield exact normalization zeta Z= product_d (1-T^d)^(b_d-ell_d-p_d)*(1-q^d*T^d)^(-ell_d). Independently enumerated all 11 cycle types and orbit spectra, verified split Fq-point result 15q-15, type (3,1,1,1) 3 rational points, (5,1) zero, and (6) q+1. Algebraic-geometric proof plus exact finite S6 group exhaustion establishes all q and all 11 etale types; finite q sample is only corroboration.
